verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a hosted SaaS API, so team sharing, organization management and role-based permissions are a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions teammates, organizations, shared scraper configurations or role-based access. The only access-related items are API-key authentication errors, which are single-key auth, not team or RBAC management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can share scrapers with teammates and manage organizations and role-based permissions
